reviews.title: Extremely Disappointing Service – Harassment, Aggressive Upselling, and Zero Respect for Clients
reviews.text:
My experience with Shaadi has been incredibly frustrating and disappointing. What is supposed to be a service that helps people find a life partner has turned into an exhausting exercise in dealing with relentless sales calls and aggressive VIP Shaadi upselling.

Despite repeatedly declining the VIP Shaadi services through messages and verbal conversations, I continue to receive calls pushing the same upgrades. I have spent hours on the phone explaining that I am not interested, yet the message simply does not seem to get through. The calls continue at absolutely ridiculous hours, including weekends and late nights at 10 PM, 11 PM, and even 1 AM in the USA. This is completely unacceptable and demonstrates a shocking lack of respect for clients’ time, privacy, and personal boundaries.

What makes the experience even worse is the way clients are made to feel as though they are not serious or genuine about finding a partner simply because they refuse to purchase additional services. Declining an expensive upgrade does not make someone less genuine about marriage. It is insulting and unprofessional to suggest otherwise.

The representatives also need to learn to listen instead of interrupting clients, talking over them, or cutting them off when they are trying to explain their concerns. A customer should not have to repeatedly defend a clear decision to decline a service they do not want.

Shaadi needs to understand that customer service is not about relentlessly pressuring peopl

reviews.title: Terrible user interface, and recurring login issues
reviews.text:
I signed up for a paid membership but have barely been able to use the platform due to ongoing issues with the account verification process. I have submitted my government-issued ID multiple times. Each time my profile gets approved, it is later deactivated again without explanation, forcing me to go through the verification process repeatedly.

What makes the experience even more frustrating is that reactivation can take up to 48 hours each time. I have contacted customer support multiple times via email, but the issue remains unresolved.

For a service that charges a significant membership fee, the customer support options are inadequate. There is no live chat support, and the only phone number provided appears to be based in India, making it difficult for many users to get timely assistance.

At a minimum, Shaadi.com should provide a toll-free support number and live chat support for paying members. The platform has potential, but the current verification and support experience has been extremely disappointing.
